name: Kawasaki Vulcan 1500 (Nomad, Drifter, Classic)
engine: 1470 cc liquid-cooled V-twin, carb or fuel injected depending on model, shaft drive
intro: The later 1500 Vulcans. Some have a carb, some fuel injection. All are shaft drive.

G: Check which you have. Carbureted bikes get the carb steps; fuel-injected bikes skip them.

recalls.years: 2003-2004 (some Classic, Drifter, Mean Streak, Nomad FI)
recalls.what: High oil pressure on a cold start can deform the oil filter cartridge.

recallNote: No recalls found for these years when this course was written. Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to be sure.

forums.name: Vulcan Riders Association
forums.what: Owner club and forum for Kawasaki Vulcans.
